script_text:
Stop! Scorpio, the stars are screaming at you right now.
Pluto, your ruler of this water sign, forms a tense square to Venus in the 7th House, stirring dramatic intensity in relationships and power plays.
Meanwhile, a harmonious sextile links Mercury in the 2nd House with Jupiter, opening a burst of financial luck and sudden opportunities.
If you're single, Pluto's magnetic square to Venus draws a bold, enigmatic partner into your orbit; if you're taken, watch for possessive tendencies that could cloud trust.
Your 10th House feels a harsh opposition from Saturn, urging you to review every commitment carefully.
A trine from Neptune to your 2nd House lifts monetary worries, opening unexpected earnings.
Steer clear of impulsive decisions under the Mercury retrograde in your 3rd House, or a hidden talent will surface like a secret sunrise.
Follow for tomorrow's reading and stay ahead of the cosmic currents.
